name: Patch Diff Panic
hook: Update the server before rogue AI bots reverse engineer the git diff
tagline: A trembling IT administrator tries to drag a massive firmware update bar while swarm algorithms disassemble the release notes in real time. Cashing out slams the server room airlock shut with pristine zero-trust compliance. Crashing lets the autonomous crawler inject a ransom prompt that turns all office monitors into ASCII skull gifs.
